typography.headings: Bebas Neue, Chivo, or Barlow Condensed (Military / Tactical impact)
typography.body: IBM Plex Mono (for stats/balances) and Inter or IBM Plex Sans (for general readability)
rules: Use tracking-tight for H1-H2, tracking-widest for small caps labels
Do not use generic sans for hero headings
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body
Use Monospace fonts for all numbers, balances, and live stats
Background is Deepest Tactical Black with a slight olive/green tint.
Primary is Night Vision Green, used for tech elements, stats, and tactical UI.
Accent is Elite Casino Gold, reserved exclusively for wins, chips, premium actions, and VIP tiers.
No large gradients. Use solid colors with 1px borders, or subtle inner glows.
Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for all text over dark backgrounds.
Hover states must shift to a lighter hue of the active state.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Combine Grid Borders (Technical Look) with Retro-Futurism (Terminal Look). Use 1px sharp borders. Add 'corner brackets' (like [ ]) to key containers to simulate HUDs or sniper scopes.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle digital noise, scanlines, or topographic map faint overlays to simulate night-vision goggles or tactical drone feed.
visual_enhancers.glow: Subtle drop-shadow glow around Gold and NVG text for high-value targets/wins.

layouts.global: Generous padding (p-8 to p-12). Flat structure.
layouts.lobby: MODE A: 'Tetris' Grid (Asymmetrical) for selecting slot machines as 'missions'.
layouts.dashboard: MODE B: High Density Grid for player wallet, history, and stats.
layouts.header: Crystal Glass or Solid Background (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md) with thick bottom border.
layouts.footer: Dark, py-20, must prominently display 'Wages of War Operations Ltd' and licence 'MGA/B2C/912/2025'.

rules: Micro-animations for hover and focus states.
No generic transition-all. Use precise transform and opacity transitions.
Wins/Spins must be explosive but concise (under 2 seconds).
Include data-testid on all interactable elements (e.g., spin-button, deposit-submit).

icons.style: Duotone or sharp weight for tactical feel.

images.description: Tactical night vision soldier for hero overlay (blend with low opacity)
Gold casino chips for VIP section, Wallet deposit, or win screens
Military camouflage texture for subtle background panels or tier backgrounds

components.name: SlotMachine
components.instructions_to_main_agent: Must feel best-in-class. Use framer-motion or CSS for spinning reels. Highlight winning paylines with bright Gold (#D4AF37) borders and NVG glows.

components.name: TargetCard (Lobby Game Card)
components.instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use standard rounded cards. Use sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), dark surface, and 1px borders. Add crosshair brackets at corners.

components.name: WalletHUD
components.instructions_to_main_agent: Display balances in IBM Plex Mono. Use high-contrast Night Vision Green for standard balance, and Elite Gold for VIP/Bonus funds.

3d_libraries.recommended: Framer Motion 3D (for card flips/slots) or TSParticles (for ambient night-vision dust/radar sweeps in background)
rules: Do not overuse 3D; keep UI flat and tactical (HUD style).

instructions_to_main_agent: Always use the exact name 'Wages of War Casino'. NEVER 'War of Wages'.
Footer MUST contain 'Wages of War Operations Ltd' and 'MGA/B2C/912/2025'.
Do not use generic blue/purple gradients. Stick strictly to Tactical Green and Elite Gold on deep black.
Do not apply global text-align: center on App.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for high-fidelity marketing/hero layouts, Shadcn for forms/dialogs.
Use sonner for toast notifications, style them like terminal output or tactical alerts.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided media URLs.
Always include data-testid attributes for testing.
Never use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT flat backgrounds.
Use glass-morphism selectively for sticky headers (Crystal variant, not muddy gray).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
